description: Faster file transfer with USB 3.1 technology Get high-performing read speeds of up to 150MB/s to transfer your important files with the Lexar JumpDrive S80 USB 3.1 Flash Drive. Quickly transfer a 3GB 4K video in less than 1 minute, compared to the 4 minutes it takes using a standard USB 2.0 drive. Available in capacities from 32GB to 256GB and includes a three-year limited warranty. * This Lexar S80 Pen Drive image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Store and transfer content faster With super-fast speeds up to 150MB/s read and write speeds up to 10x faster than standard USB 2.0 drives, you can quickly transfer a 3GB 4K movie clip in less than 1 minute, compared to the 4 minutes it takes using a standard USB 2.0 drive. Backwards compatible with USB 3.0 and 2.0 devices. * This Lexar S80 Pen Drive image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Securely protect your files Looking to protect personal information, financial records, or other sensitive files on the go?
